name: Subset Teaching Dimension / Antichain Number
witness_verification: For every n>=1, Repeated-Coordinate Cubes have STD n and AN 1 (database values 1165 and 1164). The ratio is n and diverges, so no reverse affine bound is possible. Every coordinate is active; the construction uses repeated columns, not constant padding. The STD proof verifies that the family of all ordinary minimum teachers is already a fixed point of the subset-teaching recursion. See survey Corollary cor:repeated-coordinate-antichain-separation and sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{STD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{AN}(\mathcal H)$.
